high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for the Tamil film "Annaatthe." The poster features a man dressed in traditional Indian attire, specifically a white kurta with a matching dhoti. He is wearing sunglasses and has a confident, almost triumphant expression on his face, with his hands on his hips. The background is filled with vibrant yellow and orange confetti, suggesting a festive or celebratory atmosphere. There are also golden bells floating around him, adding to the festive feel.
